title: Merck’s TROP2 ADC extends survival in pivotal gastroesophageal cancer trial
summary: Merck & Co.’s sacituzumab tirumotecan has improved overall survival in a phase 3 cancer trial, delivering a second pivotal global victory for the TROP2-directed antibody-drug conjugate.

title: Researchers may have to ‘revise a lot’ of theories about dementia after uncovering plastics in brain
summary: The field of micro- and nanoplastics has drawn a lot of interest in recent years as concerns grow about the impact of contamination in the environment. These tiny plastic particles are created when plastic breaks down and are usually so small that they are invisible to the naked eye.

title: FDA pushes decision on Belite’s eye disease pill back to May
summary: The FDA is taking a little extra time to review Belite Bio’s application for its treatment for a rare genetic eye condition, pushing the expected action date back by three months into May next year.

title: ‘It’s a very healthy sector’: Biopharma gathers in London as M&A shines and China clouds loom
summary: As the grand hotels and cosy cafes filled with biopharma executives and investors for London Life Sciences Week, the weather was as temperamental as any other English November.

title: Chutes & Ladders—Teva loses R&D head as innovation pivot advances
summary: Teva’s R&D chief has resigned a week after the company's R&D day. The White House yanked its FDA commissioner nomination at the 11th hour. Quanterix restarted its search for a CEO. And more.

title: Bausch + Lomb and Celldex rocked by respective phase 2 flops
summary: Bausch + Lomb and Celldex have independently reported phase 2 flops. While Celldex ended work in the indication in response to the setback, Bausch + Lomb noted numerical improvements and exploratory analyses to make the case for talks about entering phase 3.

title: Anthropic board director Vas Narasimhan bets AI can help Novartis solve ‘biological latency’
summary: On the same day Anthropic staged a record-shattering IPO on Nasdaq, the artificial intelligence tech giant’s lone pharmaceutical board member, Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan, was in London pitching investors on how the Swiss drugmaker is using AI to shrink drug development timelines and one day solve “biological latency.”

title: Crown Biosciences stays put as $204M Adicon deal falls through
summary: Crown Biosciences looks destined to go unworn for a while longer after its planned $204 million acquisition by China's Adicon fell through.

title: Vaccine biotech Evaxion halts infectious disease, autoimmune work to focus on oncology
summary: Evaxion is refocusing its R&D efforts to solely focus on developing and advancing its cancer vaccines.

title: nChroma halves headcount, calls time on trial of potential HBV ‘cure’
summary: nChroma Bio’s workforce is facing a second round of layoffs in 12 months, with the Boston biotech halving its headcount and scrapping a trial of its lead hepatitis asset.

title: Isomorphic adds Merck to AI drug discovery roster days after $5B raise
summary: Isomorphic Labs’ big week just got bigger. Days after raising $5 billion, the AI-powered biotech has added Merck & Co. to a list of partners that now includes three of the top four drugmakers by revenue.

title: Teva loses R&D head Eric Hughes amid push to grow innovative medicines business
summary: Teva’s R&D chief Eric Hughes, M.D., Ph.D., has resigned one week after the company showcased its push to grow its innovative medicines business.

title: AbbVie busts a move with Disco in $2.5B dance aimed at bispecific discovery
summary: AbbVie is twirling onto the dance floor with Disco Pharmaceuticals, offering up to $2.5 billion to work with the German platform company on cancer-targeted bispecific discovery.

title: Novartis CEO argues shareholders ‘happy overall’ with strategy, calls for COINS Act adjustment
summary: Despite a bumpy few months for Novartis that saw a couple of high-profile clinical setbacks, CEO Vas Narasimhan has told Fierce he believes most shareholders remain onside with the company’s strategy.

title: Majority rate home diagnostic tests ‘very helpful,’ but just 33% for accuracy: DNV survey
summary: People are twice as likely to describe home diagnostic tests as very helpful versus them as very accurate, according to new global research from the quality assurance, risk management and certification company Det Norske Veritas (DNV).

title: Less than a year into the job, Everett Cunningham steps down as Quanterix CEO
summary: Quanterix is on the lookout for a new chief executive once again as Everett Cunningham, who only started the top job back in January, hits the exit.

title: Biogen’s tau therapy drives bigger benefits in 2-year Alzheimer’s update
summary: Biogen has linked its tau-targeting antisense oligonucleotide to a further slowing of clinical decline after two years, leading analysts to hail the strengthening of evidence supporting late-phase development.

title: Pfizer enters in vivo CAR-T space via 3-program, $2.6B deal with China’s Starna
summary: Pfizer has decided to join the in vivo CAR-T race, penning a $2.6 billion deal for three preclinical candidates from China’s Starna Therapeutics.

title: At Fierce’s London event, Big Pharmas tell biotechs to ‘be transparent’ to secure deals
summary: Every biotech looking for a suitor wants to know: What does it take to charm a Big Pharma into a deal?

title: Vertex signs $220M deal with Genomics to re-up long-running discovery pact
summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals has re-upped its ties with sequencing specialist Genomics in a deal worth up to $220 million, signing on for an extra four years on top of the eight the companies have already worked together.

title: Priavoid’s Alzheimer’s pill fails to prove efficacy in phase 2 trial
summary: Priavoid’s pill for Alzheimer's disease has failed to prove its effectiveness in a phase 2 dementia study, although the German biotech pointed to encouraging signs in the longer-term data.

title: FDA clears MiniMed Fit tubeless insulin pump
summary: MiniMed announced has picked up FDA clearance of its tubeless insulin pump, the MiniMed Fit.
